homonym_warning: GAP-001 is a homonym. On the BOARD CHECKPOINT LEDGER it means 'readiness gap: reboot-recovery evidence incomplete (rider POWER_LOSS_UNTESTED)'. In the TELEGRAM REDESIGN backlog it means conversation_metadata_store_missing. This verifier checks ONLY the board checkpoint ledger. Any evidence file from the Telegram redesign context must not be fed to it.
closure_rule: Executable closure = criteria 1-5 hold AND a signed checkpoint bundle exists that records GAP-001 CLOSED with the standing rider POWER_LOSS_UNTESTED. Per D5/D14 only the OWNER formalizes closure; the board-side agent never hand-edits gap ledgers; no agent lifts the WAVE0_OBSERVE_ONLY + GITWRITE-FAILED structural gate alone.

checks.why: Proves the evidence speaks about the board checkpoint-ledger GAP-001 (has a boot_id), not the Telegram homonym.
Board payload declares GAP-001 readiness READY for the current boot.
D5 criterion: gates_failed=[] at the closing boot.

D5 criterion: two consecutive software-reboot PASS runs. Documentary (owner decision record) until a boot-report artifact with the two records is exported; upgrade path: add a JSON_PATH check against that artifact.
D5 criterion: the PASS boots ran on fresh boot_ids (no forged replay across one boot).

D5: closure is FORMALIZED only by the owner's next signed checkpoint (D6 bundle name: SIGNED-CHECKPOINT-BUNDLE). The artifact must itself contain GAP-001 + CLOSED + the rider POWER_LOSS_UNTESTED - a documentary note or a GAP-002 CLOSED_BY_SIGNED_CHECKPOINT string in ordinary evidence does NOT count. This is the check that is still open as of 2026-08-18.

Closure carries the standing rider - the gap closes for software-reboot recovery, NOT for physical power-loss recovery. Rider must also appear inside the signed bundle (enforced by OWNER-SIGNED-CHECKPOINT require_content_all).

checks.pattern: until GAP-001 formally closed. No agent lifts it alone
checks.why: D14 line 131-132: WAVE0_OBSERVE_ONLY + GITWRITE-FAILED retention is a structural gate that stays until GAP-001 formally closed; this verifier reports the gate state and never lifts flags (informational cross-check that the doctrine text is intact in the binding record).

verdict_matrix.CLOSED: all mandatory checks PASS and OWNER-SIGNED-CHECKPOINT is runtime PASS
verdict_matrix.PENDING_OWNER_SIGNATURE: criteria checks PASS/PASS_DOCUMENTED but OWNER-SIGNED-CHECKPOINT is UNKNOWN (expected state as of 2026-08-18)
verdict_matrix.NOT_CLOSED: any mandatory criteria check UNKNOWN without documentary fallback, or any FAIL
verdict_matrix.INTEGRITY_INCIDENT: any CONTRADICTED signal (e.g. GAP-001 marked CLOSED while gates_failed non-empty)
